title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono form Bag Productions Ltd | 1969
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s production company Bag Productions Ltd was formed on 21 April 1969.

Bag Productions, which was mentioned in The Beatles’ ‘Come Together’, was based out of Apple’s headquarters at 3 Savile Row. It was intended as an umbrella company for the couple’s music, films, books, and other projects, and set their work apart from the rest of Apple’s output.

On 7 May a Memorandum and Articles of Association of Bag Productions Limited was drafted, which named its shareholders as Apple secretaries Shirley Anne Mudie and Imelda Coyle.
